Performance monitoring: Review device logs, monitoring alerts, interface statistics, and traffic information to identify faults, capacity concerns, and performance degradation. Infrastructure projects: Support the provisioning and implementation of traditional and converged data center networks, enterprise LAN/WAN connectivity, and network security solutions. Understanding of server connectivity, network interface configuration, and data center networking requirements. Ability to investigate issues systematically, interpret technical evidence, and document findings clearly. Experience working in a NOC, managed services, enterprise infrastructure, or data center operations environment . Experience coordinating network changes, incident escalations, and technical troubleshooting with customers and external vendors.
